metadata.title: Seedance 2.5 API: Access, Pricing, Docs & Examples
metadata.description: Understand Seedance 2.5 API access, current BytePlus ModelArk documentation, model IDs, request structure, pricing checks, and production safeguards.

hero.title: Seedance 2.5 API
hero.description: A practical Seedance 2.5 API guide for developers comparing official access, model identifiers, asynchronous video tasks, Seedance 2.5 API pricing, input references, and deployment requirements.
hero.tip: API model IDs, endpoints, regions, prices, and supported parameters are time-sensitive. Treat the official BytePlus documentation as the source of truth.

introduce.title: What a Seedance 2.5 API integration needs
introduce.description: For searches such as Seedance2.5 API and API Seedance 2.5, separate authentication, input assets, model selection, task polling, billing, moderation, and result retention. A working request is more than a prompt string.

items.title: Authenticated access
items.description: Create an API key or approved credential in the provider console and keep it server-side. Never expose it in a browser bundle.

items.title: A current model ID
items.description: Use the model identifier published in the current API reference, such as the documented Dreamina Seedance 2.5 model, rather than guessing a slug.

items.title: Asynchronous task handling
items.description: Create a generation task, store its ID, poll or receive the documented callback, and handle queued, running, succeeded, and failed states.

items.title: A billing and safety plan
items.description: Estimate output cost, validate reference rights, log provider errors, and retain only the task data your product actually needs.

benefits.title: Plan the request around the video task
benefits.description: The most useful Seedance 2.5 API examples make every variable explicit: model, content roles, duration, output settings, callback behavior, and error handling.

items.title: Text-to-video
items.description: Send a directing brief with subject, action, camera, timing, sound, and constraints. Keep unsupported parameters out of the request.

items.title: Reference-to-video
items.description: Label image, video, or audio references according to the provider schema and make sure public URLs remain reachable during execution.

items.title: Editing and green screen
items.description: Treat edits as controlled transformations with explicit source material, timestamps, replacement instructions, and rights checks.

items.title: Result verification
items.description: Inspect status, returned URL, dimensions, duration, audio, watermark setting, and retention window before handing a result to a user.

features.title: Seedance 2.5 API checklist
features.description: Use this sequence for a small proof of concept before you add retries, queues, webhooks, or a customer-facing dashboard.

items.title: 1. Confirm service access
items.description: Check supported market, account approval, quota, API key permissions, and current terms.

items.title: 2. Read the schema
items.description: Copy the official request shape and verify content roles, URL rules, file formats, duration, and output options.

items.title: 3. Submit one short task
items.description: Start with a simple prompt and a small reference set so errors are easy to attribute.

items.title: 4. Track the task
items.description: Implement polling or the documented callback and make status transitions idempotent.

items.title: 5. Verify the output
items.description: Check the actual file metadata instead of trusting a prompt that says 1080p or 4K.

items.title: 6. Measure cost
items.description: Record input references, output duration, resolution, provider price, and failed-task billing behavior.

faq.title: Seedance 2.5 API FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: What is the official Seedance 2.5 API?
items.answer: BytePlus ModelArk publishes the current official API documentation and model identifiers for supported markets. Use its current video-generation reference rather than an unofficial wrapper as your contract.

items.question: What is the Seedance 2.5 API model ID?
items.answer: The current BytePlus documentation lists a Dreamina Seedance 2.5 model identifier. Model IDs can be versioned, so copy the value from the live reference when you configure an integration.

items.question: What is the Seedance 2.5 API pricing and price?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the provider, output resolution, duration, input video, plan, and region. Use the live ModelArk pricing page or calculator for a current estimate; do not hard-code a search-result price.

items.question: Can I call Seedance 2.5 from a client-side app?
items.answer: Keep API credentials and provider calls on a server or trusted edge function. Your client should submit an authorized job to your backend, not expose the provider key.

items.question: Does the API support 30-second video?
items.answer: The official Seedance 2.5 materials describe up to 30 seconds per generation, but your account, endpoint, mode, and current parameter limits still need to be checked in the API reference.

items.question: Does Seadance Video offer a public Seedance 2.5 API?
items.answer: No. This page is an informational guide. The site’s browser generator is separate from an official public API product; use the provider documentation for integration work.

cta.title: Validate one API task before scaling
cta.description: Use the official reference, submit a small authorized test, verify the returned file, and only then design a larger Seedance video pipeline.
